turns.prompt: Can you make my budget month start on the 15th instead of the 1st?
turns.text:
I can't change the budget month start day through the tools available to me. The budget month start day (whether it starts on the 1st or 15th) is a setting in your Tally app that you control directly.

The tools I have access to can:
- View your budgets and spending
- Set budget amounts for specific categories
- Add, update, or delete entries

But they cannot change the underlying system setting of when the budget month begins.

To change the budget month start date to the 15th, you'll need to do this directly in the Tally app itself. This is typically found in:
- Settings → Budget settings → Budget month start day
- Or a similar path in your app's preferences

Once you've changed that setting, the budget periods will automatically shift to start on the 15th of each month.
